title: Qurutob
description: A traditional dish from Tajikistan, centered on plain yogurt, greek yogurt, pita bread, yellow onion. A measured home-kitchen version organized by cooking step. Greek yogurt substitutes for dried qurut in this home-style qurutob; traditional dried salted yogurt is absent.

steps.instruction: Whisk Greek yogurt with a little water until pourable. Traditional salted dried qurut is not available for this version.
Toast these ingredients over medium heat for about 7 minutes, turning frequently to prevent scorching.
Chop the vegetables as needed. Sauté the listed ingredients over medium heat, stirring, for about 10 minutes until softened and aromatic.
Assemble the cooled components with the listed fillings or toppings. Refrigerate briefly if needed to set the layers.
